tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Filters verified products in one category by spec values (for example watts, weight, ports, capacity) and returns up to 10, each with its source URL and check date. Numeric filters use min/max objects keyed by field name; yes/no filters use flags. Every response lists the fields that category can be

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns the full verified spec record for one product, looked up by slug, model number, other model number or name, with its source URL and check date. Recalled power banks are returned with their recall notice.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Puts 2 to 4 verified products from the same category side by side and lists the spec fields where they differ. Each product keeps its own source URL and check date.

tools.name: find_gear_for_device
tools.description: Given the devices someone uses (laptops, phones, desktops, monitors), finds verified chargers, carry-on power banks, cables, KVM switches and USB-C docks whose specs cover them. Uses the same rules as the SpecSource /setup tool and returns up to 2 products per kind (10 in total).

tools.name: check_power_bank_flight
tools.description: Says whether a verified power bank can go in carry-on luggage, based only on the Wh rating the brand states (under 100Wh: no airline approval needed). Recalled models always return "recalled, do not fly". Includes the rule used and the product source.

tools.name: check_spec_claim
tools.description: Looks up recorded spec disputes: where a brand figure and other sources disagree (for example total watts or capacity), with every figure, its condition and its own source URL, and which figure SpecSource adopted (settled) or that it is still open. Search by product or by words in the question.

tools.name: find_same_product
tools.description: Finds other model numbers a verified product is sold under (same specs, different region, retailer or color), with the source for each model number.
